tw-wi-eaton-swantek-1932.st: The $10,000 cache was only the 1932 robbers' belief, and the owner denied it.
src: Green Bay Press-Gazette, 12 Oct 1932, p. 1, and 21 Nov 1932, p. 1

set.st: In April 1925 jailed burglars passed a tip, through ex-sheriff Garman, that loot from the City Bank of St. Paul robbery (28-29 Mar 1921) was buried on the old Eliza Wilson farm by Elk Creek. A 100-ft trench was dug at night in April 1925, possibly removing it. Part of the old homestead may now be under Elk Creek Lake, formed by the 1925 dam.
